contexts.text: Reason, lulled to sleep, compels the mouth to speak like a parrot.
There is a dullness in the Christian Societies... almost like that of a talking parrot.
Like ravens and parrots taught to say words from a psalm.
(Wolff urged) that parrots and the like speak, and know what they say.
If we are to believe what we do not understand, man might be taught to speak and remember like a parrot.
As there is nothing spiritual within his Rational, if he speaks about any spiritual thing of the Church, his voice is heard by the Angels as the voice of a parrot, or a goose...
